title: Ask them again if they want to be told buy a flight on 2 days notice, without any idea on reimbursement procedures, then go through two day interview
summary: Ask them again if they want to be told buy a flight on 2 days notice, without any idea on reimbursement procedures, then go through two day interview and not get picked because professor A liked you but professor or B hates A so he voted you down.
author: Greg McVerry
